name: campaign-brief
title: Campaign brief and review
for_each: select id,name from campaigns order by name

sections.title: Brief
sections.sql: select name,owner,objective,due_date,status from campaigns where id=$1

sections.title: Content and decisions
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,state,revision,planned_at from posts where campaign_id=$1 order by planned_at

sections.title: Latest results
sections.sql: select v.code,v.title,v.as_of,v.impressions,v.engagements,v.clicks from post_performance v join posts p on p.id=v.id where p.campaign_id=$1 order by v.code
sections.note: Per-post snapshots, not period totals. Unknown metrics are not zero.

name: approval-record
title: Content approval record
for_each: select id,code as name from posts where state<>'archived' order by code

sections.title: Human review evidence
sections.sql: select revision,decision,actor,evidence,created_at from approvals where post_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: A decision applies only to its recorded revision. No publication is performed.

sections.title: Outstanding checks
sections.sql: select rule,issue,source from compliance_findings where id=$1
